g.text: SS-07 Review and publish learning content
Existing course learners keep their started revision.
New starts use the latest published revision.
Unfinished diagnostic attempts keep their form.
Career-path changes do not replace accepted roadmaps.
Email failure never reverses a saved decision.
Show current state in permitted dashboards.
Administrator account support sees delivery failure,
Retry delivery only; never repeat the decision (P-01).
